text.n01: [teasing] Yo, knew you'd be up here. …What? [suspicious] Why are you staring?
text.n02: [flustered] I-it's not like I wore this for you! [annoyed] Mom made me put it on!
text.n03a: [surprised] Huh…!? [flustered] W-what's with you all of a sudden. …Idiot. [shy] …Hmm. So it suits me, huh.
text.n03b: [annoyed] Excuse me!? What's that supposed to mean! [pouting] …You could at least say I look cute.
text.n04: [sighs] It's so hot, though… [playful] Here, I got a soda popsicle. …We'll split it.
text.n05: [teasing] Here, your half. [laughs] …Did you just go 'eek'? Too easy.
text.n06: [nostalgic] We used to split these up here too, remember? [teasing] You always took the bigger half.
text.n07: [annoyed] Ugh, it's way too hot! I'll fan you, so scoot over.
text.n08: [pouting] It's not for you or anything. I'm just hot, that's all.
text.n09a: [laughs] Don't push your luck. [softly] …Fine, fine, just a little more.
text.n09b: [pouting] …What's that? And here I was, fanning you.
text.n10: [playful] Ta-da, sparklers. Left over from last year. [softly] …I'm lighting them.
text.n11: [teasing] It's a contest. Whoever's drops first does one thing the other says. [whispers] …Move and you lose.
text.n12a: [surprised] Ah… [sighs] mine dropped. …Tch, I lose. Fine, I'll do anything. [nervous] …But first, let me say one thing.
text.n12b: [laughs] Ha, you lose! [nervous] …Then you have to listen to me. All the way to the end.
text.n14: [nervous] You know, for a long time now, I've… you…
text.n15a: [flustered] N-nothing! [sighs] …Is what I'd like to say, but.
text.n16: [whispers] …I've liked you… for a long time, maybe. …I'm not saying it twice.
text.n17b: [shouting] Huh!? That's so unfair! [laughs] …Ugh, you're such an idiot.
